tools.heading: Proven tools, chosen for the job

entries.a: AEO is the practice of structuring your website and content so AI answer engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews — understand your business and cite it when people ask relevant questions. It builds on SEO, but the goal is to be named in the answer, not just listed in the results.

entries.q: How long does a typical engagement take?
entries.a: A focused website project usually runs four to eight weeks. AEO, SEO and social media work is typically ongoing, with meaningful results building over three to six months.

entries.q: Do you work on a project or retainer basis?
entries.a: Both. Website builds and redesigns are usually fixed-scope projects. AEO, social media, email and analytics tend to work best as monthly retainers.

entries.q: Can you improve an existing site rather than build from scratch?
entries.a: Yes. If your site's foundations are sound, targeted work on speed, structure, content and AEO is often the better investment. We'll tell you honestly which route makes sense.

entries.q: What kinds of businesses do you work best with?
entries.a: UK and international B2B and service businesses that sell considered purchases — where buyers research, compare and ask questions before they enquire. Our clients include a financial market data provider and a business centre.

entries.q: What does the first conversation look like?
entries.a: A 30-minute call about your goals and where things feel stuck. If you've asked for an AEO audit, we'll bring a snapshot of how you currently appear on Google and in AI answers. No hard sell.

cta.heading: Ready to build a growth system that performs?
cta.body: If your website, funnel and marketing feel disconnected — or AI search is naming your competitors instead of you — we can align them into one sharper system that gives the right buyers every reason to choose you.
